events.title: 체스터 시티 are relegated to the Football Conference after 69 years of Football League membership. On the same day, 맨체스터 시티 secure promotion to the Premier League as Division One runners-up (their second successive promotion), 월솔 suffer relegation to Division Two, 번리 secure promotion to Division One as Division Two runners-up, and Northampton seal the third and final automatic promotion place in Division Three. 체스터 시티's place in the Football League will be taken by Conference champions Kidderminster Harriers .
셰필드 웬즈데이 are relegated from the Premier League after nine successive seasons of top-flight football, but go down fighting with a 3–3 draw against 아스널.

ITV announces a £500 million bid to bring live Premier League matches onto terrestrial television for the first time. If the deal goes ahead, it will be the first time since 1992 (when the Premier League was created from the old Football League First Division ) that live top division football has been shown on any terrestrial television channel.

윔블던 lose 2–0 at 사우샘프턴 and are relegated to Division One after 14 years in the top flight, and 12 years to the day after their FA Cup triumph over 리버풀. 브래드퍼드 시티, meanwhile, confirm their survival with a 1–0 win over 리버풀, who surrender a Champions League place to 리즈 유나이티드.
코펜하겐 UEFA컵 결승 주변 충돌 — 갈라타사라이와 아스널의 UEFA컵 결승이 열린 코펜하겐에서 관중 충돌이 발생했다. 경기 결과와 별개로 원정 관중의 안전과 치안이 문제가 됐다.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 sell Marc-Vivien Foé to 리옹 for £6 million.
첼시 wins the FA Cup by a 1–0 win over 애스턴 빌라 .

첼시 beat 애스턴 빌라 1–0 in the last FA Cup final to be played at Wembley before the 77-year-old stadium is rebuilt. Roberto Di Matteo , who scored for 첼시 in the opening minute of their 1997 triumph, scores the only goal of the game.

입스위치 타운 seal promotion to the Premier League after a five-year exile by defeating 반즐리 4–2 in the Division One playoff final at Wembley. It is their first win at Wembley since they won the FA Cup in 1978.
아스널 sign Cameroon defender Lauren for £7.2 million from 마요르카 .
맨체스터 유나이티드 pay a national record fee for a goalkeeper when they sign AS AS 모나코 and France goalkeeper Fabien Barthez for £7.8 million.
